label: Akasa Saver — 24-72h band, capped at 100% of airfare
warnings: QP-DOM-STATED-20260512: Corrected 2026-09-08 against the preserved copy. The earlier encoding was wrong in four ways: it stated an effective date of 2026-05-12 (the copy says 'effective for bookings made from 20th August 2025 onwards'), omitted the 0-24h band entirely, recorded the 24-72h fee as uncaptured when the copy states it, and used a 4h cut-off where the copy says two (2) hours.
QP-DOM-STATED-20260512: Fee is 'INR X or 100% of the airfare charge (whichever is lower)', encoded as LESSER_OF with an AIRFARE_100PCT cap — a cheap ticket can never owe more than it cost.
QP-DOM-STATED-20260512: The copy also states a no-show penalty of 100% of the airfare. Not encoded as a band: no-show is outside the passenger-initiated cancellation scope of this rule.
